en_US.title: Biometal Resource Stack

en_US.field_note: If every sample says Xenon-Omega, the world becomes stupid. Count the other reasons too.

en_US.external_site: Biometal Resource Stack frames HECTON-8 as a full pressure economy. The game can reward exploration with many resources while keeping blue debt as the strategic apex.

ru_RU.title: Ресурсный стек biometal
